key_timings.name: CRUISE_CARRY
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: local root quiet and slightly loaded; parent translates +X at steady cruise while rider key remains unchanged
key_timings.causal_role: stable carry proves parent translation does not spend rider-local timing bandwidth

key_timings.name: ASYMMETRIC_PRE_BRAKE_COIL
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; heels planted, left knee carries more compression
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: COM drops down-left against impending support deceleration; left side compresses while right arm opens forward
key_timings.causal_role: authored anticipation/coil makes the incoming inertial event legible before peak load

key_timings.name: DECEL_SHOCK
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; feet unchanged, load spikes toward forefoot
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: support deceleration spikes; pelvis lags less than chest/head, producing forward shear without changing foot topology
key_timings.causal_role: INERTIAL_JOIN impact emphasis: material support-load change earns a local re-key

key_timings.name: LOW_CATCH
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; deep bilateral catch, left knee more compressed
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: COM drops after shock; knees absorb load while torso remains ahead of pelvis
key_timings.causal_role: catch converts shock into grounded resistance and prevents an unreadable one-frame snap-back

key_timings.name: LOADED_BRACE_HOLD
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; same feet, sustained forward shear carried through bent knees
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: local brace freezes for readability while PLATFORM_CLOCK continues changing position under sustained deceleration
key_timings.causal_role: readable loaded hold demonstrates parent/local clock separation under continuing world motion

key_timings.name: RELEASE_OVERSHOOT
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; feet remain planted as shear drops
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: when support acceleration returns toward zero, stored brace releases past neutral; chest leads left while feet stay attached
key_timings.causal_role: overshoot prevents endpoint interpolation and gives the brake event a consequence

key_timings.name: UPPER_CHAIN_LAG
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; lower body recenters before head/right arm
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis begins returning but head and distal right arm lag one beat behind, preserving directional history
key_timings.causal_role: secondary lag separates root recovery from upper-chain recovery

key_timings.name: RECOVERY_DEBT
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; bilateral stance recovered but left side remains more compressed
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: COM recenters incompletely; head/shoulder line retains residual left bias instead of resetting to idle
key_timings.causal_role: recovery debt keeps force history visible after acceleration has ended

key_timings.name: CRUISE_AFTER_DEBT
key_timings.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; planted, residual shoulder asymmetry retained
key_timings.motion_arc_root_note: platform returns to constant velocity; local body is stable but not byte-for-byte idle reset
key_timings.causal_role: settled consequence closes the phrase while preserving a trace of the event
